step1_analysis.description: A clocked sense amplifier that uses a high-impedance differential input pair to steer the discharge of a cross-coupled inverter latch. It precharges the outputs to VDD when disabled and amplifies small differential input voltages to full CMOS logic levels when enabled.

paper_reference.title: Yield and Speed Optimization of a Latch-Type Voltage Sense Amplifier

sensing_delay.description: Time from the enable signal (EN) rising to 50% VDD until the output resolves to 50% VDD.

paper_reported.value: Not explicitly given, but optimized for low sensitivity to DC bias

sky130_expected.calculation: Depends on load capacitance and transistor sizing. With 1.8V supply, 1.26V input common-mode (70% VDD), and 100mV differential input, delay is dominated by the discharge path through M3, M6, and M9.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Typical sense amplifier delays in 130nm-class nodes are in the 100-200ps range for moderate loads.

input_offset_voltage_std.description: Standard deviation of the differential input voltage required to flip the latch, caused by device mismatch.

sky130_expected.calculation: Mismatch is inversely proportional to sqrt(W*L). With W=5u, L=0.5u, the area is relatively large, leading to low mismatch.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The provided netlist uses large devices (5um/0.5um), which will yield a low offset standard deviation, comparable to the optimized 8.5mV reported in the paper.

power_consumption.description: Average power consumed during a sensing cycle.

sky130_expected.calculation: Dynamic power P = C_load * VDD^2 * f. For a single event, integrate the VDD current over the switching window.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Power is mostly dynamic, consumed by discharging internal nodes and load capacitors, plus short-circuit current during the latch flip.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure sensing delay and power consumption. Applies a 100mV differential input at the optimal 70% VDD common-mode level (1.26V for a 1.8V supply) as recommended by the paper.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Latch-Type Voltage Sense Amplifier Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VEN EN 0 PULSE(0 1.8 1n 50p 50p 2n 5n)
* Input DC level = 1.26V (70% of 1.8V), diff = 100mV
VINP INP 0 DC 1.31
VINN INN 0 DC 1.21

XM1 SO SON N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 SO SON VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 SON SO N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 SON SO VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N1 INN COM GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N2 INP COM GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 SO EN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 SON EN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 COM EN GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}

* Load capacitors
C1 SO 0 10f
C2 SON 0 10f

.control
tran 10p 5n
* Measure delay from EN rising to SON falling (since INP > INN)
meas tran t_delay trig v(en) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(son) val=0.9 fall=1

* Measure average power during the sensing event
let pwr = -i(VVDD)*1.8
meas tran avg_pwr avg pwr from=1n to=3n

print t_delay avg_pwr
quit
.endc
